name: a_block_moves_with_its_own_margin
description: LAYOUTPERF8 latent bug B, fixed by FIX9 1.6. A stylesheet change of a block child's own margin-left (0 -> 40px) must move it to x=40 (a fresh layout of the same page puts it there). On the wave-7 build it stayed at x=0: a clean node is a CLONE that carries the box props (margins, padding, border) resolved from the OLD cascade, and the css-dirty channel only marked it dirty - it was re-solved with the stale margins, from its old slot. Now the reconcile builds a css-dirty node fresh and a Full-scope change is laid out by the parent. Run: target/release/azul-doc e2e scripts/layoutperf8_e2e

css: html, body { margin: 0; padding: 0; width: 100%; height: 100%; }
html, body { margin: 0; padding: 0; width: 100%; height: 100%; }
